# Complete CSV export for import history

Description

Provide a full CSV export endpoint for the import history (not only current page) to allow operators to retrieve complete logs.

Acceptance criteria

- Endpoint returns full CSV for a filtered import history query.
- Pagination/streaming implemented to avoid memory issues.
- UI offers an "Export full history" action.

Reference

Source: BACKLOG.md — "Exportación CSV completa del historial".
